title: Continue XSD assessment after a content cursor rejects
api_or_output: Bound repeated content-failure diagnostics while preserving descendant assessment and all refusal semantics

acceptance.description: Reproduce with the existing verified matcher: a small content model followed by over 1024 harmless unmatched siblings exhausts Diagnostics1024. Repair must finish complete-invalid with one initial content-failure diagnostic, original source location and unchanged limits. Preserve the three actual Z034 diagnostic-limit failures as pending counted-matcher integration evidence, never count standalone witnesses as those original executions.

Use per-run per-frame content-fault state separate from validity. On first semantic Accept=false after polling, report content error and disregard both failure-path outputs; later children bypass only that failed cursor and continue global-declaration, xsi:type or open assessment. Do not infer local declarations, skip subtrees or filter diagnostics globally. Suppress only the failed cursor completion duplicate; successful strict wildcard and unfaulted missing-content behavior remain.

Prove later datatype/required attribute/fixed/content and strict-wildcard errors, independent parent faults, attribute errors not disabling matching, balanced ordered identity hooks and later key/keyref/ID/IDREF checks. Preserve ordinary independent diagnostic exhaustion, shared work/depth/token/document limits, cancellation including null caps, caller exceptions, DOM mutation detection and repeat/concurrent isolation.

Pass focused evaluator/identity/content/facade regressions, unchanged public and frozen APIs, normal and true XML-only consumers, planning validation, and actual bounded allocation evidence using existing infrastructure under a fresh root lease. No matcher/compiler/shared-contract change, raised cap or forced completion.

handoff.summary: Planned narrowly owned evaluator repair from exact-policy counted matcher failures; accepted design in coordinator brief. Independent verified-matcher witnesses prove this repair before counted matcher consumes it.
